title: Defer incomplete slices only after covered tail + 1
body:
**Chose:** in `handed_qa`, scan only incomplete slices whose `number > max(covers).saturating_add(1)` for Prove / pre-`Depends on` `**Source**:` FR ids before deferring.
**Over:** every incomplete slice (`status != done`), which falsely deferred FR-1 at checkpoint 1 when slice 2 was still pending on the board with the same Prove needles as slice 1 (`tests/checkpoint_send_back.rs`).
**Because:** the PRD wants later slices that still own an FR to defer checkpoint proof; the slice-immediately-after the covered window is not an owner yet, only a future prover.
**Undo:** drop the `saturating_add(1)` offset and restore the PRD’s literal scan.
